summary: 1 question: r70/r71 against r16 and r55.
questions: Do r16 and r55 reach `work delegate`? Lines concerned: [r70] "**When** `work delegate` is run, `work` shall write the delegation whichever side's turn it is." (added) and the person's answer that either side may run `work delegate`; r16 ("a command other than `work resolve` ... in the other side's turn ... refuse") and r55 (a side writing the other side's part is refused when the asker is not the upstream itself). Reading A (recommended): the delegation belongs to neither side's part, so r16 and r55 do not reach `work delegate`; no line changes. Reading B: r16 and r55 are retired and redrafted with "other than `work resolve` and `work delegate`".
